note: Per-robot presentation for the public site, reviewed by hand (Javier, 23 Nov 2026; images for popular robots authorised the same day). Keyed by catalogue id; 'recorded' must equal the Lab and Robot values of that catalogue record, or the entry stops applying and the check fails, so a reordered master never moves an image or a link to another robot. 'display_name' replaces only the name shown (titles, headings, lists); slugs, permanent URLs, relations and the master keep the recorded name. 'order' links to the maker's own order page: an outbound link, no purchase or payment on Why Humanoid?, and no claim about availability or delivery; its host must be the host of the record's Web field. Add an entry only with values supplied or checked for that robot; never infer one. Checked by node tools/robot-presentation.mjs --check.

1.display_name_reason: The visible name drops the descriptor "(Home Robot)" carried in the Robot cell (row 2 of the Humanoids tab since the first catalogue export of 16 Nov 2026); the master keeps it.
